purpose: profile a hybrid reference candidate with five static views and two bracketing dynamic views

source_references.moving_selection: the two exact 100 Hz keyframes bracketing the logged query pose
source_references.static_precomputation: cache fixed-camera visibility and query-time source indices once per episode

geometry.static_labels: reuse actual fixed-camera pixels and depths from all five observed references
geometry.moving_labels: project only the bracketing source samples by source-body-to-interpolated-target-body SE3; rasterize same-label continuous triangles
geometry.visibility: per-pixel nearest interpolated depth across moving surfaces and observed static background
geometry.unobserved_or_ambiguous: request full direct render; no spatial inpainting or threshold change

radiometry.temporal_interpolation: log-domain interpolation between bracketing observations of the same frontmost label and depth
radiometry.single_sided_observation: temporally hold nearest actual source sample and report separately

evaluation.full_direct_render_fallback: charged once per requested target frame
evaluation.occlusion_audit: separate missing-moving-front, false-moving-front, and wrong-link label mismatches against exact direct render
evaluation.unsupported_event_overlap: direct-reference event overlap is a sensitivity diagnostic only, not a filtered candidate stream
evaluation.old_checkpoints: diagnostic only; trained on previous event-generation domain
